BiblicalUsage: haddâbâr means a counsellor, a vizier. In Daniel 3:24, the text says "and said unto his counsellors." In Daniel 3:27, the text says "and the king's counsellors."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that haddâbâr matters because God's Word means what it says, and this word is part of how He speaks plainly to us. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: Daniel in the Lions' Den; Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace; Nebuchadnezzar's Humbling
